formatting_pitfalls.description: ATS cannot read images and may skip entire sections
formatting_pitfalls.recommendation: Remove all images, photos, and graphics

formatting_pitfalls.description: Multi-column tables can cause text to be read in wrong order
formatting_pitfalls.recommendation: Use simple single-column layout or simple lists

formatting_pitfalls.description: ATS often cannot extract text from text boxes
Content in headers/footers may be ignored by ATS
formatting_pitfalls.recommendation: Put important info in main body

formatting_pitfalls.description: Decorative fonts may not be parsed correctly
formatting_pitfalls.recommendation: Use standard fonts: Arial, Calibri, Times New Roman, Garamond

formatting_pitfalls.description: Fonts smaller than 10pt may be unreadable
Certain special characters can break ATS parsing
Some ATS cannot handle .pages, .odt, or image formats

content_pitfalls.description: ATS may not recognize sections with creative titles
ATS needs to find email and phone easily
content_pitfalls.recommendation: Put contact info at top in standard format

content_pitfalls.description: ATS may not match acronyms to full terms
Unicode symbols may not be recognized
Keyword stuffing can be detected and penalized
Resumes over 2 pages may not be fully parsed
content_pitfalls.recommendation: Keep to 1-2 pages for most roles
